name: The London West Hollywood
positioning: All-suite hotel off the Sunset Strip, officially The London West Hollywood at Beverly Hills, with a guests-only rooftop pool
best_for: Travelers who want a suite base between Beverly Hills and the Sunset Strip
Guests who want a rooftop pool with city views

facts.text: The hotel is located at the crossroads of Beverly Hills and central LA.
The hotel is off the Sunset Strip.
The hotel was formerly the Bel Age hotel.
Suites have oversized spa-like baths by Waterworks.
Rooms are like bright studios with velvet sofas.
The lobby is shimmering white and gold.
The rooftop pool is exclusively reserved for hotel guests and has a spacious sundeck.
A courtesy house car offers drop-off within a 2-mile radius of the hotel.
All guests can use the Complimentary Breakfast Table in Boxwood Restaurant each morning.

highlights.text: The rooftop pool has private cabanas and views of the city.
The suites were designed by David Collins Studio and Richard Design.
Suites include oversized bathrooms with walk-in showers, deep soaking bathtubs and private balconies.
The hotel has a 110-seat state-of-the-art screening room.
A personal concierge service offers access to exclusive LA attractions.

considerations.text: The courtesy house car offers drop-offs only; it does not offer return pickups.
WhataHotel notes limited on-site dining options; several good restaurants are a short stroll away.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the hotel's luxury positioning.
